desc: The weight under a cut, a body hitting the ground, a title card landing.
prompt: one single heavy low-frequency thud, a large sandbag dropped onto a wooden stage floor, fast attack, short decay, dry, close microphone, no reverb, silence before and after
negative: music, melody, rhythm, speech, tonal, reverb, echo, repeating
note: One bed gives you the low thud ONLY. A film impact is a thud plus a crack plus a tail; generate metal_clang or glass_break as a second bed and AudioMerge them. Fights dialogue at 100-250 Hz, so duck the bed under lines rather than turning it down everywhere. Trim the head so the attack is on your cut frame - the model does not put the transient at t=0 reliably.

evidence.method: audio_sweep: rendered + measured (ffmpeg ebur128/silencedetect, librosa flatness)
evidence.note: renders and is not broken [seconds=2.97, lufs=-8.9, true_peak=3.0, silent_fraction=0.34, channels=2]

evidence_history.method: nothing has checked this card against pixels
